overview: Benin is a country in West Africa, on the Gulf of Guinea. Its official capital is Porto-Novo, while Cotonou is its largest city and seat of government. The area was home to the Kingdom of Dahomey, and Benin became independent from France in 1960. French is the official language, and Benin is the birthplace of the Vodun religion.

geography.text: Benin is long and narrow, stretching north from a short Atlantic coast lined with lagoons. Behind the coast is a fertile plateau, and the north is savanna, rising to the Atacora Mountains in the north-west. Pendjari National Park in the north is one of the last strongholds of lions in West Africa.
